guides.favoredWhen: She denies your passive, dodges W return, Es your Q. Punish E2-less windows.

keyTips.text: She denies passive procs: rake only when it sticks.
She dodges W return: aim the first half, never the return.
She Es your Q, engages R, saves E2: bait E before committing.

tips.text: Like Fizz, her instant full combo kills you if low: never stay low.
She saves E2 for your commit: force it before R.
Her R engage answers your R: hold yours for hers.
She plays for the low-HP all-in: roam before she can force it.
Passive denied plus E2 baited: the Akali who never Es first never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: She refuses to stack with the wave, sidesteps W returns, and respects your all-ins. Pick her or the CS.

keyTips.text: She refuses to stack with your wave: your W is trade and farm, so rake both.
She makes you pick her or the CS: never get neither.
Both W passes enable your jump and passive: land both.

tips.text: She steps sideways not back at your W: lead laterally.
She respects your level 2 and 6 all-ins with Ignite: force at spikes.
Her early HP or Cloth Armor blunts you: roam when she turtles.
She dodges the return: double-cast angles.
Picked plus returned: the Syndra who never chooses wrong never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: Skill matchup. He never melees, uses range, and answers your R with his. Punish W-Q-ins.

keyTips.text: He refuses melee, using range: close with W-Q.
He respects your burst and pokes from range: his trades are bad, so force good trades.
His Sweeper finds Q during your R stealth: R from fog.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: His range poke forces bad trades: W-Q in, R out.
He plays the skill matchup at range: your W-Q is the only engage, so make it count.
Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.
His backwards combo answers your W-Q in: Q after he shadows.
He Rs your R or Ws to kite: bait the answer before committing.
